dataset: NOAA OISST v2.1 sea-surface temperature and sea-ice concentration, DAILY, 0.25 degrees — family 7.2d

grid.align: point — row r is latitude -90 + 0.25 r, column c is longitude -180 + 0.25 c (family 7's g025 grid)

qc_policy: OISST publishes no per-value flag in these files. PSL's missing value (-9.97e36) is dropped as a sentinel; land is NaN; the `icec` file's 0..1 valid range is trusted over its 'percent' units string (build_family7.ice_divisor), and below 0.15 OISST itself reports no ice (NaN). Bilinear from the cell centres with the seam wrapped; an all-NaN neighbourhood stays NaN. Out-of-bounds values become NaN and are counted, never clipped.
sources: https://huggingface.co/datasets/chfrank/earth-tensors/resolve/main/mirrors/psl/Datasets/noaa.oisst.v2.highres/{sst,icec}.day.mean.<YYYY>.nc (the Hub's round-trip-verified mirror of NOAA PSL)
